source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main. Discovery used GitHub Search API queries for repositories created since 2026-08-12 matching MCP, agent, browser agent, LLM app, RAG, workflow and automation terms. Selected repository README files were fetched through the GitHub API raw README endpoint. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, hardware-tested, credential-tested or security-scanned.
trend_observations: Fresh AI-native product activity is concentrating around governed execution surfaces: MCP gateways with policy and observability, coding-agent handoff and orchestration layers, visible browser agents with human confirmation, and local-first code intelligence. The strongest projects expose concrete run paths, release or CI evidence, and explicit safety boundaries. Thin API wrappers and plugin catalogs remain useful ecosystem signals but are weak standalone product candidates.
assumptions: Stars, forks and timestamps are point-in-time GitHub API metadata, not exact growth deltas. Scores emphasize product surface, user scenario clarity, runnability evidence, README completeness, safety posture and recent creation or update signals. README claims are directional and were not independently runtime-verified. No install, Docker, npm, Cargo, Python, Swift/Xcode, browser extension, robot hardware, model-provider, OAuth, payment, security or production deployment audit was performed.
